subject.title: feat(ui): publish host style variables to embedded MCP apps

question: Should OpenClaw merge and own this interim Control UI-to-MCP Apps variable mapping now, with a stated replacement path to the shared Carapace embed-token contract?
rationale: The implementation and current browser proof support the feature, but choosing whether a temporary translation layer is an acceptable durable ownership boundary is product and architecture intent that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Accept the interim mapping
options.body: Merge the additive mapping as a documented temporary host contract and retire it when Control UI adopts the shared embed-token surface.

options.title: Require the shared-token migration first
options.body: Defer this PR until Control UI can source the standardized variables from the canonical embed-token contract rather than maintaining a translation table.

recommendation.title: Accept the interim mapping
recommendation.body: Merge the additive mapping as a documented temporary host contract and retire it when Control UI adopts the shared embed-token surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This member supplied the implementation, design rationale, proof update, and is currently assigned; an additional Control UI owner should confirm the final architectural choice.
